title: 镜海档案

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：轻侧视女祭司、闭合书、双镜柱和远处海上廊桥可辨，镜面未见重复人物；仅执行者选定母版，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original full-frame opaque 1024x1536 vertical fantasy tarot master, High Priestess theme 镜海档案 / Mirror Sea Archive. Reference card gives identity: exactly one serene dark-haired veiled priestess with natural skin and two hands laid over ONE clearly CLOSED ornate book; pomegranate fruit and branch discreetly at one side. Create a clearly new scene in indigo-violet, silvery white and tiny warm gold: seated figure viewed at a slight angle between exactly TWO tall mirror-clad columns staggered front-to-back, opening toward a long archive corridor over a calm sea. The mirror surfaces reflect architecture, sea and light ONLY, never a second or partial person or duplicate book. Priestess and book unobscured. Her seat and broad reflective stone plinth are physically complete, connect to visible steps and extend to lower bleed. Fine engraved celestial frame, high-end hand-painted fantasy tarot, deep spatial perspective, subtle pearly reflections. One priestess, no extra figures, no open book, no lettering, title, numbers, pseudo-text, watermark or logo. Opaque full-canvas master for later layering.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 人物、纱、手与闭合书一组；柱与远廊留背景；本主题支撑归属：镜面台基与座位完整，反射仅环境. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture.
